concrete_risks: The coat has 34.0345% of selected surface area in two indexed components whose combined vertex capacity is about 160.48 roots below their combined proportional share. Sampling without replacement must redistribute that nominal share; it cannot reproduce every old area allocation.

A unique source ID is not a unique point: coat/cream/dark contain 1439/618/978 duplicate-position excess vertices, with up to 32/40/32 aliases at one point. Selecting two aliases can stack tufts despite without-replacement sampling.
Many aliases are real UV seams; 183 coat and 25 cream groups also have normal differences above one degree. Do not weld, choose an arbitrary alias, average colors/normals or drop roots to hide this.

The dark region has 6774 eligible IDs and 5796 distinct positions for 456 tufts, with no component or coarse-grid quota saturation measured. That is capacity evidence, not evidence that dark fur looks dense.

The unchanged nominal square-root area per tuft is about 67.2 mm in all three materials. It is an allocation scale, not a visible gap or physical hair density; layer geometry, native fibers and occlusion are not measured here.
decision: Nominal capacity supports an opt-in experiment, but unchanged counts do not guarantee unchanged spatial coverage or a full coat.
measurement_qualifiers: Only one bounded source-data census ran. Root selection was not executed; no actual candidate distribution is asserted.
Grid areas use triangle centroids, not clipped surface cells. Component labels follow indexed topology and can reflect UV seams; no anatomical labels are inferred.
Nearest-own-corner distances are upper bounds to nearest eligible vertices, not lower bounds or renderer footprint coverage.
No texture decode, native render, provider call, AI-role call, production edit or Git action occurred.
RSS monitor captured no sample before exit; self-reported high-water was 111738880 bytes. Runtime 0.262 seconds, child PID 91534 exited verified.
required_candidate_evidence: Preserve exactly 2017/527/456 roots, original total 3000, eligible material/triangle ownership and explicit source vertex IDs; fail on insufficient eligibility rather than shrink counts.

Bind each root to its actual source vertex/UV corner/normal/skin tuple. Record selected coincident-position multiplicities and per-component and fixed 6x6x6 cell counts; disclose any capacity-driven redistribution.
Report selected-root area-allocation residuals against the preserved face-root baseline where exact old roots are available; limited saved root samples are not the complete old distribution.

Use matched rest/motion images at 720 and 256 pixels with unchanged cameras, materials, flow, counts, lighting and background. Inspect coat, cream and dark separately, including seam/pole clustering, bare-looking coarse cells and silhouette spikes.
Keep full-motion attachment, native/exported image and resource gates unchanged. Exact one-hot ownership resolves a root attachment mechanism, not appearance or subject identity.
